Task: Improve the understandability of the test `RandomUtilsTest.java` (path:- /Users/tenghaha/Projects/New_Agent_understandability_improvement/local_workplace/commons-lang/src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/RandomUtilsTest.java). Do not alter the runtime behaviour of the original test: the same methods must be called with the same arguments and produce the same expected outcomes.

I'll read both the original test file and the CUT source to understand the code before improving it.Now I'll write the improved test file with better understandability: descriptive parameter names, consistent Javadoc on all tests, assertion failure messages, and a clarifying comment on the always-true boolean assertion.Now I'll compile-check the generated test.The improved test compiled successfully.
